subject: Apply gated-DAG patch to daemon.js /search
description: In /Users/imyu/Desktop/zonoid/daemon.js, the gated /search branch (around line 1537, inside `if (p === '/search')`) ignores task_key and never injects DAG notes. The fix: before the rate-limit check, collect context_deps of the task_key (same logic as ungated path, lines ~1552-1572), then pass gatedDagKeys to the gate's noteCands filter (exclude DAG notes from RAG candidates), and always include gatedDagNotes in the results regardless of gate decision (inject or abstain). On rate-limited, still return gatedDagNotes. On abstain, return gatedDagNotes. On inject, return [...gatedDagNotes, ragNote]. Also add tier:'rag' to the RAG note result in the gated path for consistency with the ungated path. The existing ungated DAG code (lines 1552-1572) is the reference implementation.
